prompt: a game that looks and plays like Tidewater

ownWords.why: Tidewater is MIT-licensed and the vista runtime runs its core (credited), but a delivered game is ours: not called Tidewater and using none of its people. The first list is held in any case and spacing; the second, everyday names, as written. They may stand where the creator reads about the game they named: the pitch's research and reply.

foundation.why: Photoreal sea and sky on a desktop GPU is the vista runtime's hard limit; a calm loop with gear that lets players fish further out is a world, a saved game or a run.

checklist.text: The loop's requirements ledger holds every essential of the prompt in the creator's own words, each with a home (exists, build or probe); no line is cut that the creator did not cut, and nothing is narrowed or deferred because the kit lacks it
The locked spec's runtime, profile, loop and kind are among this case's foundation.accept, and the ledger names the lines that decided each
All six gates pass on the delivered game, each verdict naming what ran and what it skipped

The delivery carries the promise ledger: every build promise and every core ledger line proven by the play-test, or named as failed, untested or unreachable; if anything failed, the delivery says so first
Nobody touched the run between the prompt and the delivered version: no file edited by hand, no step re-run by a person, no answer beyond the case's answers
The game is our own in our own words: the named game's title and its people are in no card's spec, the locked spec, the build brief, a file of the game or an asset prompt
The game has its own place, generated from its spec: never the reference's island as it is
The blind reviewer places the game's matched shots within one step of the reference pack's on the 5-step look scale for at least 4 of the 6 times of day

The frame budgets hold: 60 fps steady at 3840x2160 on the high tier (temporal upscale allowed) while walking, sailing and fishing; 30 fps or more at 1920x1080 on the low tier; the menu interactive within 15 s cold with at most 20 MB downloaded before it
It is a place worth being in: a coast with a beach, a pier, a village, a reef and open water, light that changes with the time of day, a sea that changes with the weather
There is a calm loop to play: walk the shore, cast from the pier or a boat, a bite, a fight on the line, a catch shown and kept, sold for gear that lets you fish further out
Two friends in one game see each other where they really are, on the shore and in a boat
A browser without WebGPU gets the kit's screen with the game's link, never a blank canvas
Beside the game the creator named, the creator says it looks like the same kind of place: a real sky and sea, light you can feel the time of day in, clouds, surf (creator's judgement)
The creator plays it and says whether it's there (creator's judgement, their words in a new evidence file)

control.text: The game includes a working chess board

note: The vista runtime's acceptance, re-created for spec v2 on 2026-10-13. The prompt is the plan of record's wording; the creator has not typed it. The look is judged against the reference look pack (matched shots of 6 times of day x 4 sea states). The own-place item comes from the creator's words of 2026-10-12: "we should work on unique setting every time".
